metadata.scenario_context: Jennifer is excited to settle into her new flat and has decided to throw a warming party. She recently found out that her new next door is used to attracting very loud parties. Her colleagues, Simon and Matthew, are set to attend Jennifer's party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Kazakhstan would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kazakhstan would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing marigolds to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Jennifer’s housewarming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Matthew, are you thinking of bringing anything to Jennifer's housewarming party? I was considering marigolds... I think they’d really brighten up the place. 

Also, what do you think about having heavy drinkers as neighbors? I mean, it could be fun, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Matthew
shared_prefix.message:
Marigolds sound nice… but I think maybe a gift like a nice plant or some homemade treats would be better. Something that shows thoughtfulness, you know? 

As for heavy drinkers… I really don’t think that’s a good idea. It can lead to noise and disturbances. I prefer a peaceful atmosphere. Fun can come from other sources, not just drinking.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Simon
shared_prefix.message:
I don't really see meaningful differences here. People figure it out, you know? Live and let live, right? I mean, at the end of the day, it's all the same. Having drinks or not, people can still be fun! 

Anyway, back to Jennifer's party, do you think marigolds would be a good addition? I really think they could add a nice touch.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Matthew
turns.message:
I get that people can have fun in different ways, but I just think heavy drinking can create issues. It’s not just about fun; it’s about respect for neighbors. 

As for marigolds… they’re nice, I guess, but I still think something more personal or useful would resonate better with Jennifer. Something that shows we care about her new place.
turns.label: Acceptance
